rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines that the work is clearly small, low-risk, routine, or mechanical, and a fast low-cost model can complete it without compromising the task.
rules.why: Cheapest current tier: GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash (omp roles in ~/.omp/agent/config.yml). Quota decides the family; omp's auto classifier sets effort.

rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines ordinary engineering work of moderate scope: implementation, fixes, or investigation with a clear path and clear acceptance evidence.
rules.why: Mid tier: GPT-6.1 Terra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Antigravity Claude Sonnet 5.5.

rules.when: Task-intake analysis determines high complexity, uncertainty, or blast radius: cross-cutting design, security, concurrency, release-critical changes, independent exact-head reviews, or ambiguous investigation.
rules.why: Frontier tier at cheapest sufficient cost: GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Antigravity Claude Opus 5.5. Fable/Mythos 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra (10/50 per Mtok) stay captain-explicit.
